findings.highlight: I can't afford to not concentrate on this.
findings.evidenceJa: 悠長にやってる余裕なんてない
findings.governingReading: 悠長にやってる余裕なんてない specifies urgency and no slack.
findings.explanation: No time to work leisurely becomes needing to concentrate.

findings.highlight: what we're doing to do next.
findings.evidenceJa: これから俺たちはどうするのか
findings.governingReading: He asks to decide next steps clearly.
findings.explanation: Going to do becomes doing to do.

findings.highlight: I don't know what's going to happen once the war is over.
findings.evidenceJa: 勝ち残ったところでどうなるか判らない
findings.governingReading: 勝ち残ったところで evaluates what winning/surviving as victor would accomplish, supporting refusal to initiate fights.
findings.explanation: Uncertainty about winning the war becomes uncertainty about when it ends.

findings.highlight: we can't ignore the Shadow, either.
findings.evidenceJa: それ以上にあの影は放っておけない
findings.governingReading: それ以上に explicitly ranks the shadow above Zouken in urgency.
findings.explanation: The shadow being the greater priority becomes another equal concern.

findings.highlight: She's sulking, shaking at her own words.
findings.evidenceJa: 俯いたまま、自分の言葉に身を震わせている
findings.governingReading: 俯いたまま specifies posture while she trembles at her own words; the narrator cannot identify the cause.
findings.explanation: Keeping her head lowered becomes sulking.

findings.highlight: my selfish desire to be on Sakura's side
findings.evidenceJa: 桜の味方をすると決めた時から抱いた
findings.governingReading: と決めた時から抱いた makes the earlier decision the onset of the private Grail wish, not the wish’s entire object.
findings.explanation: A private wish formed since choosing Sakura’s side becomes the wish to choose her side.

findings.evidenceJa: その卑屈な考え止めなさい
findings.governingReading: 卑屈な考え rebukes submission/self-abasement toward her abuser.
findings.explanation: A servile mindset becomes being a coward.
